'''Cane Adiss''' was a [[Yuvernian]] member of the [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]'s [[Jabba's criminal empire|criminal empire]]. He was present in [[Boba Fett's Palace|Jabba's Palace]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] when the [[Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca]] was taken [[prisoner]] there, and also witnessed the capture of [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] after she [[Rescue of Han Solo|freed]] the prisoner [[Han Solo]] from [[carbonite]]. Adiss then accompanied Jabba on the [[sail barge]] ''[[Khetanna]]'' to witness Solo and his allies [[Death|executed]] at the [[Great Pit of Carkoon]], but the prisoners escaped and destroyed the barge.

==Biography==
During the [[Imperial Era]], Cane Adiss was a member of the [[Jabba's criminal empire|criminal empire]] of the [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]].<ref name="Geektionary" /> In [[4 ABY]],<ref name="GA">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the [[Rescue of Han Solo]] to [[4 ABY]].</ref> he<ref name="Geektionary" /> spent [[time]] in [[Boba Fett's Palace|Jabba's Palace]] on the [[desert]]<ref name="ROTJ" /> [[planet]]<ref name="Geektionary" /> [[Tatooine]] while the Hutt held the former [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]] as a [[prisoner]] frozen in [[carbonite]] there. [[Heroes of Yavin|Solo's friends]] eventually launched a [[Rescue of Han Solo|mission]] to rescue him, with [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] and Solo's [[Wookiee]] companion [[Chewbacca]] arriving at the palace while Organa was disguised<ref name="ROTJ" /> as the [[Ubese]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Boushh]].<ref name="Geektionary" />

After threatening Jabba's court with a [[thermal detonator]] during negotiations, Organa claimed the [[bounty]] on Chewbacca, and the Wookiee was taken away to the palace's [[prison]] by [[Gamorrean]] guards, who dragged him past where Adiss was stood in Jabba's throne room. Organa remained in the palace, but Jabba had seen through her deception and set a trap,<ref name="ROTJ" /> hiding with his favorite courtiers<ref name="Odyssey">''[[The Odyssey of Star Wars: An Epic Poem]]''</ref> behind curtains in the throne room around where the frozen Solo was kept. Adiss was among a large group of courtiers who hid on a stairwell leading down into the throne room opposite where Jabba lay in wait, with Adiss in the doorway at the top of the stairs. Later that [[Standard day|night]], Organa snuck into the throne room and freed Solo, only for Jabba to reveal himself once the carbonite had thawed. As Adiss and the others watched, Solo was taken away to the prisons and Organa was brought to Jabba and [[Slavery|enslaved]].<ref name="ROTJ" />

The following [[Standard day|day]], the [[Jedi Knight]] [[Luke Skywalker]] arrived in the palace and confronted Jabba, but was imprisoned with Solo and Chewbacca and sentenced alongside them to [[death]]. The prisoners would be fed to the [[sarlacc]] that dwelt in the [[Great Pit of Carkoon]], and Adiss was among those who accompanied Jabba to the pit on board the Hutt's luxury [[sail barge]], ''[[Khetanna]]'', in order to view the execution. At the pit, Adiss watched with Jabba from the viewing deck; however, the prisoners managed to free themselves and Organa killed Jabba, leaving his courtiers in disary. She and her allies then destroyed the barge and escaped.<ref name="ROTJ" /> It was unknown whether Adiss died in the explosion, or not.<ref name="Geektionary" />

==Personality and traits==
Adiss was a member of the [[Yuvernian]] [[species]]<ref name="Geektionary" /> with [[Color|blue]] [[eye]]s<ref name="CL" /> and yellow skin. The shorter of Adiss' heads had lighter brown spots and had a more bulbous head shape. The taller of Adiss' heads had darker brown spots and three protrusions at the back of the head.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:CaneAdissMaquette-Chronicles.png|thumb|right|150px|The prototype model of Cane Adiss]]
Cane Adiss appeared in the [[1983]] ''[[Star Wars]]'' movie [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars:'' Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="ROTJ" /> He was later identified in [[2016]] by the [[Star Wars video games|mobile app]] ''[[Star Wars: Card Trader]]''.<ref name="SWCT">{{SWCT|set=Topps Choice 2|cardname=Cane Adiss}}</ref> The character was first named in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity in the "[[Jabba's Palace Limited]]" set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]],<ref name="Jabba's Palace">{{CCG|set=Jabba's Palace Limited|cardname=Cane Adiss}}</ref> released in [[1998]].<ref name="SWCG3">{{CollectorCite|3|It's All In The Cards}}</ref>

A prototype maquette of the character was created for the film, and differed from the final puppet in that the green-spotted head had a large crest above it rather than protrusions, while the other head had orange rather than brown spots. Constructing the final puppet required scaffolding.<ref name="chronicles">''[[Star Wars Chronicles]]''</ref> Revealed during a panel for [[Wikipedia:FanX|Salt Lake Comic-Con]], the production name for Cane Adiss was "Cane Heads."<ref name="RotJ Creature History">{{SW|url=news/return-of-the-jedi-creature-history-with-pablo-hidalgo|text=''Return of the Jedi'' Creature History with Pablo Hidalgo|nolive=1}}</ref> The several scenes including the Cane Adiss puppet were filmed on Stage 8 at [[Elstree Studios]], in [[Wikipedia:London|London]], [[Wikipedia:England|England]] between January and February of [[1982]].<ref name="The Making Of">''[[The Making of Return of the Jedi]]''</ref> [[Tom St. Amand]] worked on the design for  the two creatures that became Cane Adiss's sculpt, and ended up creating the model twice, when he put his first sculpt into the oven and forgot to take it out in time, resulting in him throwing out the original pair. He ended up regretting that decision, with the wish he kept the burnt creature sculpts.<ref name="Maquette Masters">{{InsiderCite|231|Maquette Masters}}</ref>
